name: Iligan Open 2016
information: Registration fee starts at Php 200.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on December 23, 2016 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no walk-in registrations on the day of the event. This is the official return of Iligan in the Speedcubing scene since Iligan Open 2008 which took place 8 years ago. Please dress appropriately as this is an official WCA event.
